---
name: design-systems
description: Create maintainable design tokens, reusable components, themes, and UI standards across web and mobile.
---
# Design systems
- Audit existing visual patterns before introducing new tokens or components.
- Define semantic tokens for surfaces, text, borders, status, spacing, typography, radii, elevation, and motion.
- Keep components composable with documented variants, sizes, states, and accessibility behavior.
- Ensure dark/light themes preserve semantic meaning and contrast.
- Avoid duplicating near-identical components or scattering raw color values.
- Document usage examples and migration steps; validate tokens on real screens and breakpoints.
